"use client" import { ContentPageHeader, DashboardShell } from "@/lib/feature-kit/layout" import { useMemo } from "react" import { CommonUploaderButton, type UploaderConfig } from "@/lib/feature-kit/uploader" import { BlockPageRoot } from "@/components/blocks/block-page-root" import { LayoutShellSidebarSlots } from "@/components/examples/layout/shell/layout-shell-shared" import { demoAccountUploaderColumns } from "@/components/examples/uploader/demo-uploader-columns" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card" const slots = LayoutShellSidebarSlots() export function UploaderImportBlock() { const config = useMemo( () => ({ entity: "demo-account", entityLabel: "accounts", title: "Import accounts", description: "Upload a CSV or Excel file using the sample template. Rows are validated in the browser; no API is called in this demo.", fileFormat: "standard", templateFileName: "demo-account-import-template", acceptedFileTypes: ".xlsx,.csv", columns: demoAccountUploaderColumns, defaultMode: "create", transport: "records", historyHref: "/docs/blocks/uploader-import", }), [], ) return (
Start import Opens the uploader dialog with column mapping and row-level errors. { await new Promise((resolve) => { window.setTimeout(resolve, 500) }) return { success: true, message: `Imported ${records.length} row(s) (demo only).`, } }} /> Before you upload

1. Download the template and fill required columns.

2. Keep headers on the first row.

3. Review validation results before confirming.
) }
